name: Rishab Chouhan
bio: Results-oriented Software Engineer with over two years of hands-on experience across full-stack development, machine learning, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices. Proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions as a core contributor to the technical success of three Australian startups. I specialize in building scalable, user-centric applications with a strong emphasis on performance, security, and maintainability. Ask my AI assistant about my projects and experience!

experience.description: Built a high-performance Ethereum L2 blockchain application with TypeScript, Node.js, and React.js, ensuring scalability and security. Designed and implemented backend architecture for decentralized database integration with potential IPFS adoption. Developed and deployed smart contracts (Solidity, EVM) while integrating zkSync & zkRollups to boost transaction throughput (80% faster, 99% cheaper vs. L1).

Led full-stack development across backend (Java/Kotlin, REST APIs), frontend (React.js), and infrastructure (Docker, AWS EC2), building secure, scalable systems from scratch. Integrated Deepgram's speech-to-text API and GPT-4 for automated medical documentation workflows, reducing clinician admin time by over 40%. Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker, improving deployment reliability and reducing release time by 50%.

Collaborated with a team of researchers working on AI automation of additive manufacturing/3D printing soot analysis during SLM (Selective Laser Melting). Developed data pipelines and analytical models using Python (pandas, scikit-learn), enabling automation of real-time estimation of soot formation on layers. Improved the existing DSCNN ML model to enhance error handling efficiency by 80%.

projects.title: Platstock — Retail Investment Intelligence Platform
projects.description: A mobile-first personal finance platform democratising investing for retail investors. Connects to live brokerage accounts, tracks portfolios with TWR and risk metrics (Sharpe, VaR, drawdown), surfaces ML-driven insights, and runs counterfactual simulations — 'what if you had bought X instead?' — powered by the Vestara Counterfactual Intelligence Engine (VCIE) with Behavioral Transaction Fingerprinting and Monte Carlo scenario modelling.
projects.contribution: Architected the full-stack platform end-to-end: Expo mobile app with pure SVG charts, FastAPI Python engine for portfolio analytics, Supabase BaaS with 19 SQL migrations and RLS, 8 Deno edge functions, and the VCIE simulation pipeline including behavioral profiling, cash-flow replay, and decision impact trees.

projects.title: Decentralized Prediction Market Platform
projects.description: A multi-tenant pari-mutuel prediction market on Ethereum (Sepolia testnet). Operators register betplaces and deploy categorised markets (stocks, crypto, sports, politics); users purchase an ERC20 settlement token and stake on outcomes. Winners split the total pool proportional to their bet — odds emerge from stake distribution, not an AMM. Three live markets deployed for NVDA, BTC, and AAPL.
projects.contribution: Designed and deployed four interacting smart contracts — a custom ERC20 with ICO engine (ETH + stablecoin purchase), a pari-mutuel Market with reentrancy-guarded payout, a MarketFactory registry indexed by tenant and category, and a TenantRegistry with on-chain JSON metadata. Built the React/Vite frontend with ethers v6 for market browsing, betting, and admin flows.
